member.name: T:CustomPlantClass.Unmanaged.MemoryPatch

member.name: P:CustomPlantClass.Unmanaged.MemoryPatch.Address

member.name: M:CustomPlantClass.Unmanaged.MemoryPatch.FromRva(System.String,System.Int64,System.Byte[],System.Byte[])
member.summary: Creates a patch at a module-relative address.

Relative virtual address of the patch.
Bytes to write when the patch is enabled.
Optional bytes that must currently exist at the patch address.

member.name: M:CustomPlantClass.Unmanaged.MemoryPatch.FromPattern(System.String,System.String,System.Int32,System.Byte[],System.Byte[])
member.summary: Creates a patch at an offset relative to a unique signature match.
member.param: Name of the loaded module to search.
Space-separated hexadecimal bytes; use ? or ?? as a wildcard.
Offset from the start of the matched signature.
Bytes to write when the patch is enabled.
Optional bytes that must currently exist at the patch address.
member.returns: A patch initialized with the bytes currently at the target address.

member.name: M:CustomPlantClass.Unmanaged.MemoryPatch.Enable

member.name: M:CustomPlantClass.Unmanaged.MemoryPatch.Disable
member.summary: Restores the original bytes, unless the patch is already disabled.

member.name: M:CustomPlantClass.Unmanaged.MemoryPatch.Dispose
member.summary: Restores the original bytes if needed and releases this patch object.
